taxonomy: Three-branch LSTM + CNN bilinear attention over date and time-point matrices
framework.target: Next-hour household total electric load from previous 168 hourly values
framework.input: UMass Smart home dataset, selected 2014 first three quarters; original half-hourly to hourly conversion unspecified
branches: Jump-sampled time-point matrix -> LSTM query + CNN local values -> bilinear attention -> Hadamard fusion -> FC
Segmented date matrix -> analogous local attention -> FC
framework.aggregation: Three scalar branch outputs added; explicit unnumbered equation p9 and Figure 5
framework.theory: Sequence memory, convolutional locality and normalized attention; empirical architectural rationale, no theorem or causal identification
framework.not_established: Attention interpretation is not independently validated; forecast accuracy does not establish demand-response, pricing, energy savings or carbon reduction.

equations.audit: Input gate uses i while remaining expressions use t; V-cell terms introduce peephole-like dependencies but diagram has no explicit such paths. Implementation correspondence unverified.
Text references this equation for same-shape padding, but padding sizes are not specified mathematically.

equations.role: Softmax local scores; weights sum to one
equations.audit: Normalization is an attention mechanism, not calibrated forecast uncertainty.

equations.role: Hadamard product of query and weighted local value
equations.audit: Introduction p5 says element-wise addition; source contains inconsistent fusion descriptions.
Mean symbol has an i subscript and lacks explicit definition; standard shared-target interpretation used conditionally in numeric audit.
Zero handling changes evaluation population; removal is reported but legitimate zero demand versus anomalies not distinguished.

equations.role: Squared L2 prediction residual called MSE
equations.audit: Printed left side is (theta) with no named loss; no 1/n. Mean/sum convention requires implementation clarification.

equations.role: Weighted sum of FC-transformed local features

figures.audit: No percent mark on axis and plotted mean levels do not transparently reconcile with Table 2 MAPE percentages; underlying errors and aggregation not supplied.
Displays dispersion, not run-to-run confidence or statistical significance; sample unit not explicit.
Same Load(kW) label as Figure 6 but about 0-1 scale and very similar trajectory; normalization/display transformation needs explanation, not assumed identical underlying samples.

tables.audit: Baseline recurrent hidden size64 vs Full128; Full adds branches/CNN. Printed 1D-CNN conflicts with HxW formulation and 2x2/3x3/4x4 experiment; printed exponential decay e^0.98 is not a factor below1.

TLA best printed values across six metrics; shared-target pooled R2/MSE compatibility fails even allowing three-decimal rounding. This is conditional arithmetic, not evidence of fabrication; macro-averaging or differing targets might explain it but are not described.
3x3 best all metrics. 4x4 higher R2 but worse MSE than2x2; impossible for same-target pooled formulas, requiring aggregation clarification.

experiments.question: Does full TLA-LSTM beat SVR/RFR/RNN/LSTM?

experiments.question: Which local convolution size performs best?

statistics.training: 8:1:1 train/validation/test; Adam lr1e-3, two recurrent layers, early stop10; baseline hidden64 vs full128; minibatch/maxepoch/seed not reported

statistics.leakage_boundaries: Split chronology, sliding-window partition order and training-only normalization not stated. Risk identified, actual leakage not established.
statistics.repeats_CI_pvalues_effect_sizes: Not reported; error boxplots are not seed replicates or inferential tests.
statistics.compute_resources: Environment names printed, but no runtime, parameter count, FLOPs, peak memory, cost or implementation version hash.
statistics.physical_evaluation: No operational closed-loop control, cost, energy savings or carbon calculation.
